notes.understanding:
Spirit analysis of the prolongation tower.

(1) Structure of E_k. The Einstein series Ric(e^H) − λe^H at order k is multilinear in the jets H_j with Σj = k. It is therefore linear in every H_j with j ≠ k/2, and quadratic only in H_{k/2}. By parity, odd jets vanish, so E_6 is linear in H4 and H6 (H3 = 0). The order-6 residual (15 conditions after absorbing by H6) is a linear system in H4 with H2-dependent coefficients. Full rank 15 at a generic quadric point (established mod p) is an algebraic property, so it holds at generic real quadric points too. Hence order 6 is solvable over R, and the D=8 LM stagnation is an optimizer artifact, not an obstruction. Test: take the converged D=6 (H2, H4) and solve the order-6 linear system for (δH4, H6) directly.

(2) The right computation is the exact linear tower, mod p, at a generic quadric point: at order k solve linearly in the two newest jets, with the only nonlinearity in H_{k/2}². Track the dimension of the formal variety through orders 8–12. Stabilizing dimension = finite type (strictly AKE germs with a nondegenerate torsion zero form a finite-dimensional family, consistent with the cohomogeneity-one Fino/A01 examples). Growing dimension = Φ has identities off the Kähler locus, and no local obstruction exists.

(3) The naive count (conditions ~K⁴/48, parameters ~K³/6) predicts finite type, but the Kähler locus (A_k rank 0, infinite KE families) shows identities exist there. Whether they persist off the Kähler locus is exactly the finite-type question.

(4) Over C the formal variety is an algebraic family in λ; the sign of λ cannot appear. Any λ<0-specific obstruction must be a reality phenomenon and should be examined only after the complex dimension is known.
